decisions.reason: It builds on existing glass-silicon and through-contact knowledge, allowing the firm to interpret early results and improve the product.
Carrier wafers are a direct extension of the firm's core glass and quartz wafer manufacturing, requiring no new knowledge to assimilate.
The copper interposer glass wafer leverages existing through-glass via and metallization R&D, giving the firm enough absorptive capacity to learn and refine it.
The off-the-shelf brand is essentially the firm's established glass and quartz wafer business repackaged, so it is fully within existing knowledge.
Glass-based circuit boards require circuit-board manufacturing expertise far from the firm's core wafer processing, limiting its ability to assimilate and improve the product.
